title: mT5 Bidirectional EN-TR Machine Translation (ONNX INT8 & ORT Mobile)
description: Fine-tuned an mT5-small model with 8-bit LoRA for bidirectional English-Turkish translation, achieving a 0.6245 METEOR score. Reduced model size 5x (from 500MB to 100MB) and optimized performance for resource-constrained environments by applying model pruning, ONNX compilation, and INT8 quantization for mobile deployment via ONNX Runtime (ORT Mobile).
techStack: Python, PyTorch, Transformers, LoRA, Fine-Tuning, ONNX Runtime, NLP

title: Zettelkasten AI Notes (Pupilica AI Hackathon — Top 10 Finalist)
description: A privacy-first desktop knowledge management application implementing the Zettelkasten method using Python and Flet. Features a Dual AI Engine (Google Gemini and Vulkan-accelerated local GGUF models) with a Two-Tier In-Memory Vector RAG Pool, CPU cross-encoder reranking (Qwen3), and local embeddings (Harrier-0.6B) to synthesize atomic notes without duplicate concepts. Includes an interactive canvas mind map, live Markdown editor with LaTeX, smart WikiLinks, and SQLite WAL persistence.
techStack: Python, Flet, SQLite, RAG, llama.cpp, Gemini API, NLP

title: Apple Detection and Quality Analysis System
description: An industrial computer vision application featuring real-time object detection, physical dimension measurement, and CIEDE2000 color quality analysis. Focused on system integration, designing the application architecture, and orchestrating the end-to-end pipeline—integrating the camera SDK, real-time YOLOv8-seg model inference, and measurement modules into a unified desktop interface.
techStack: Python, OpenCV, YOLO, PyQt5, Computer Vision

title: Arduino PC System Monitor
description: A TinyML-powered system that monitors PC hardware resources (CPU, RAM, GPU, VRAM) and automatically optimizes power consumption. The system extracts hardware telemetry in real-time, executing an on-device SVM classification model on an Arduino Leonardo to determine and adjust the system's power state.
